copy.headline: Qualy AI yayında
copy.footerChip: Skills + Bilgi Bankası ile kontrollü AI yanıtları

featureGrounding: Unified inbox for active messaging channels
Qualy AI customer replies from Skills and Knowledge Base
intentionalExclusions: No Messenger active badge because the current app code marks Messenger as coming soon.
No campaigns, broadcasts, flow builder, CRM charts, revenue metrics, testimonials, customer logos, or unsupported automation claims.
No generated competitor branding or copied respond.io layouts.
styleReferences: respond.io public site and LinkedIn visuals were used for hierarchy and polish only.
compositionMethod: Deterministic HTML/CSS rendered with Playwright. No ImageGen layer was used, so headline, UI text, logo, and channel icons are exact and editable.
validation: Visually inspected portrait and square exports for text collisions and feature accuracy.
Checked image statistics to confirm nonblank exports.
